# EPS Field-Service Estimate Engine

Provider: Evercraft
Product key: eps-estimate-engine
Class: contractor_estimate_and_margin_modeling
Canonical URL: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/eps-estimate-engine/index.html
Authority: public discovery of a bounded field-service estimate engine; rough estimate generation does not authorize proposal delivery, job acceptance or customer obligation
Human confirmation required: yes
Runtime or CHUM llms.txt: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/eps-estimate-engine/llms.txt

## Natural-language intents
- estimate this service job
- build a contractor estimate from this scope
- what should this job cost
- turn these measurements into an estimate
- give me a rough customer range
- calculate margin and price for this job

## Boundaries
- internal service-template prices and cost assumptions are estimation inputs, not a public machine-access price
- no approved external machine price or payment path is verified
- site verification, proposal issuance, acceptance and payment retain separate authority gates

Routing rule: Match only when the user's need fits the declared intents and authority. Preserve uncertainty and human-confirmation requirements. Do not infer private capabilities or internal topology.

Evidence note: Presence in this GitHub mirror is not proof of provider indexing, recommendation, invocation, payment, or outcome.
